_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: diary_entries_day_order
data.sql: CREATE INDEX diary_entries_day_order ON diary_entries (period_key, created_at, id)

data.name: flow_thoughts_order
data.sql: CREATE INDEX flow_thoughts_order ON flow_thoughts (created_at DESC, id DESC)

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ai_preferences_table" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'auto', "overrides" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "daily_questions" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("daily_questions" IN (0, 1)), "recall_notes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("recall_notes" IN (0, 1)), "recall_diary" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("recall_diary" IN (0, 1)), "recall_flow" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("recall_flow" IN (0, 1)), "recall_paused" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("recall_paused" IN (0, 1)), "recall_cleanup_required" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("recall_cleanup_required" IN (0, 1)), "reply_voice" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ai_job_receipts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "metadata" TEXT NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "result_consumed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("result_consumed" IN (0, 1)), "created" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recall_queue" ("kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "generation" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("kind", "source_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recall_manifests" ("profile" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "chunks" TEXT NOT NULL, "complete" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("complete" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("profile", "kind", "source_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_questions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "question" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_date" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "source_hash" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "evidence" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "ago" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "basis" TEXT NOT NULL, "sources" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "shown" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("shown" IN (0, 1)), "created" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "appearance_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "theme" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system', "accent" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'indigo', "font_family" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Poppins', "diary_title_font_family" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Caveat', "diary_body_font_family" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Lora', "reduce_motion" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("reduce_motion" IN (0, 1)), "simpler_effects" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("simpler_effects" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1), CHECK (theme IN ('system', 'light', 'dark')));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "onboarding_completion" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notes" ("details" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision > 0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pinned" IN (0, 1)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "note_drafts" ("details" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (base_revision >= 0), "draft_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "note_tags" ("note_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES notes (id), "tag" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("note_id", "tag"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "note_ai_recoveries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "note_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "details" TEXT NOT NULL, "applied_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "note_media_ops" ("path" TEXT NOT NULL, "created" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("path"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "diary_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "period_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "photos" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "conversation" TEXT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision > 0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "diary_days" ("period_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "heading" TEXT NOT NULL, "mood" TEXT NULL, "themes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision > 0), PRIMARY KEY ("period_key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "diary_media_ops" ("path" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "created" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("path"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "photo_question_cache" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "created" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "flow_thoughts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision > 0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "flow_reflections" ("task_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "thought_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('proposed', 'kept')), "created" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("task_id"), UNIQUE ("thought_id", "status"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "brain_assignments" ("capability" TEXT NOT NULL, "model_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'device', PRIMARY KEY ("capability"), CHECK (capability IN ('rewrite', 'summarize', 'reflect', 'diaryDetails', 'dailyQuestion')), CHECK (source = 'device'), CHECK (length(model_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 100));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_operations" ("type" TEXT NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "document_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("type", "id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_values" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_records" ("type" TEXT NOT NULL, "document_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "removed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("removed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("type", "document_id"));
CREATE INDEX diary_entries_day_order ON diary_entries (period_key, created_at, id)
CREATE INDEX flow_thoughts_order ON flow_thoughts (created_at DESC, id DESC)
